text: {"lessons":["My early sales of Stock B and C locked in gains, but selling just because a position is profitable can cut short future returns; I should use a clear plan for when to sell.","Selling Stock D and E after very large losses was painful, but refusing to admit a mistake can let losses grow; I should review whether my reasons for holding still hold and set risk limits in advance.","Adding to Stock B and C as their prices fell did not prevent further account declines; before averaging down, I should reassess the investment case and consider how the added exposure affects my overall portfolio."]}
